answer: According to Section 2(29) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, a person is said to have 'reason to believe' a thing if he has sufficient cause to believe that thing but not otherwise. This definition establishes that the belief must be based on adequate grounds.
summary_answer: 'Reason to believe' means having sufficient cause to believe something.
